text: Winning the AI Race: Strengthening U.S. Capabilities in Computing and Innovation. Witnesses included Sam Altman, Lisa Su, Michael Intrator, and Brad Smith.
summaryKo: 샘 올트먼·리사 수·브래드 스미스 등이 참석한 미 상원 청문회에서 미국의 AI 컴퓨팅 역량과 혁신 정책을 논의했다.
rationale: The hearing spans AI software, compute, and public policy; QQQ is used as a broad listed-technology basket rather than as a directly owned asset.

text: Tesla furnished its first-quarter 2025 financial results under Item 2.02 of Form 8-K after the U.S. market close.
summaryKo: Tesla가 미국 장 마감 후 Form 8-K를 통해 2025년 1분기 실적 자료를 공시했다.
rationale: TSLA is the direct listed issuer. The SEC acceptance timestamp is used, so the after-hours filing aligns to the next trading session.

text: NVIDIA announced that it was working with manufacturing partners to produce NVIDIA AI supercomputers in the United States for the first time.
summaryKo: NVIDIA가 협력사들과 함께 미국에서 처음으로 NVIDIA AI 슈퍼컴퓨터를 생산할 계획이라고 발표했다.
rationale: NVDA is the direct listed issuer behind the announcement. Publication time was not exposed, so alignment uses the published date and is labeled date-precision.

text: OpenAI introduced GPT-4.5 as a research preview and described it as its largest and most knowledgeable model for chat at the time.
summaryKo: OpenAI가 당시 가장 크고 지식이 풍부한 채팅 모델로 GPT-4.5 연구 프리뷰를 공개했다.
rationale: OpenAI is private. MSFT is explicitly labeled as a partnership proxy, not as direct OpenAI equity.

text: OpenAI and SoftBank announced the Stargate Project, a new company intending to invest $500 billion over four years in AI infrastructure in the United States.
summaryKo: OpenAI와 SoftBank가 미국 AI 인프라에 4년간 5,000억 달러를 투자할 계획인 Stargate Project를 발표했다.
rationale: NVDA is a listed compute-infrastructure proxy named as a technology partner, not equity in the private Stargate entity.

text: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT search with timely answers and links to relevant web sources.
summaryKo: OpenAI가 최신 정보와 웹 출처 링크를 제공하는 ChatGPT 검색 기능을 공개했다.
rationale: OpenAI is private. MSFT is labeled as a partnership proxy rather than direct OpenAI equity.

text: OpenAI introduced GPT-4o as its newest flagship model and expanded advanced ChatGPT capabilities to free users.
summaryKo: OpenAI가 새로운 플래그십 모델 GPT-4o를 공개하고 ChatGPT 무료 사용자에게 고급 기능을 확대했다.
rationale: OpenAI is private. MSFT is labeled as a partnership proxy rather than direct OpenAI equity.

text: NVIDIA and computer manufacturers announced Blackwell-powered systems for enterprises to build AI factories and data centers.
summaryKo: NVIDIA와 주요 컴퓨터 제조사들이 기업용 AI 팩토리와 데이터센터를 위한 Blackwell 기반 시스템을 발표했다.
rationale: NVDA is the direct listed issuer behind the Blackwell systems announcement.

text: NVIDIA announced the Blackwell platform for real-time generative AI on trillion-parameter models.
summaryKo: NVIDIA가 초거대 생성형 AI 실행을 위한 Blackwell 플랫폼을 발표했다.
rationale: NVDA is the direct listed issuer behind the Blackwell platform announcement.
